subject: Encryption pathways, PII retention, and residency - next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Encryption pathways, PII retention, and residency - follow-up

Hi Oliver — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of what I heard:
- FinEdge will process customer PII (names, limited payment metadata) via API calls to the inference service.
- Regulatory preference: primary residency in us-west region, with EU as backstop for EU customers.
- Security requirements: in-transit TLS, at-rest encryption with customer-managed keys preferred; ability to produce key access logs and rotate keys on demand.
- Retention: default transient KV cache; FinEdge needs a max retention window of 30 days for logs and ability to purge on DSR (data subject requests).

Open questions for us to confirm:
1) Do you require FIPS-140 validated HSM for key custody, or is cloud KMS (AWS KMS with CMKs) acceptable with strict IAM bindings?
2) Is shared-hosted (Redwood API) acceptable if we provide dedicated encryption paths and isolation commitments, or do you need Private (VPC/on-prem) from day one?
3) Do you have specific logging retention windows for audit logs vs application telemetry?

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll attach a short matrix that maps our BYOK, KMS, and HSM options and what evidence we can provide (KMS key policy, key rotation logs, HSM attestation).
- Vanessa (CC) will follow up with a targeted checklist for SOC2 / encryption artifacts.
- If you can share the procurement timeline, we’ll prioritize the right deployment path.

Attached: redwood-kms-options.pdf (high level options).

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finedge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@finedge.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T17:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Encryption pathways, PII retention, and residency - follow-up

Thanks Marcus — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

Answers and constraints:
- HSM vs KMS: We prefer BYOK and a customer-managed key. AWS KMS CMKs are acceptable if the key lives in an AWS account we manage and you support an external-key-ARN binding. FIPS/HSM is preferred for keys that encrypt stored PII.
- In-transit: TLS 1.2 minimum; mutual TLS (mTLS) would be ideal for high-sensitivity endpoints.
- At-rest: AES-256, with separate key encryption key (KEK) controls. We also need proof of rotation frequency (annual rotation minimum) and ability to revoke access immediately.
- Retention: Audit logs (access logs, key usage) kept 365 days; application logs (request traces) can be 30 days but must be deletable on request.
- Residency: US-west primary. EU region required if data originates from EU residents.

Procurement timeline: procurement team aiming to issue PO by 2027-02-15; security review completes by 2027-02-01.

I’m attaching the initial security questionnaire (answers being compiled by our security team).

— Oliver
Oliver Grant
Head of Platform Security, FinEdge
oliver.grant@finedge.com

Attachment: finedge-security-answers.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finedge.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Encryption pathways, PII retention, and residency - follow-up

Oliver — adding a couple of notes from the commercial/ops side to make sure the deployment choice aligns with procurement timing: 

- If FinEdge opts for AWS-managed CMK in your AWS account (BYOK via cross-account key grants), we can support Hosted API with isolated key bindings; that typically shortens time-to-prod and fits your Feb PO timeline.
- If you require FIPS-level HSM attestations or an on-prem HSM, Private deployment (VPC or on-prem appliance) will be necessary and will add ~6–8 weeks for provisioning and paperwork.
- For pricing and billing: BYOK on your AWS account requires minimal add-on; dedicated HSM or Private deployment will be priced as a dedicated capacity line item.

Happy to map this out on a decision table — Marcus, Vanessa, can you confirm the artifacts we’ll provide for each option so the security team can review quickly?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finedge.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-11T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Encryption pathways, PII retention, and residency - follow-up

Oliver — short checklist from security so you know what we can produce immediately vs what requires additional ops: 

We can provide (immediately):
- KMS key policy template and cross-account grant example for AWS CMKs.
- Audit logs: key usage logs (CloudTrail) for the AWS account where the CMK lives; we can export and retain for 365 days on request.
- TLS configuration: cipher list and proof of TLS 1.2+ for all endpoints; optional mTLS guidance.
- Data-retention controls: API flags to set explicit retention windows and a purge endpoint for DSRs.

Requires provisioning / time:
- FIPS-140 HSM attestation data (if you require our HSM-backed private deployment) — needs scheduling and procurement (~6 weeks).
- On-prem HSM integration or customer HSM plug-in — engineering project, estimate 8–10 weeks depending on site.

Please share the questionnaire results and preferred KMS approach. If you confirm AWS CMK in your account, we will send a one-page runbook (grant steps + minimal IAM policy) and a short evidence pack (CloudTrail snippets, key rotation logs).

Vanessa Ortiz
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com

From: procurement@finedge.com <procurement@finedge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@finedge.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Encryption pathways, PII retention, and residency - follow-up

Hi all — procurement here. A couple quick asks to keep the PO on schedule: 

1) Please confirm the following in writing by 2027-01-18 so we can attach to the SOW:
   - Residency guarantee for us-west for US traffic, explicit fallback to eu-west for EU traffic.
   - Confirmation that BYOK (AWS CMK in our account) is supported and that Redwood will provide a runbook for cross-account grant.
   - Statement on retention windows: audit logs 365d, app request traces 30d, purge on DSR within 48 hours of request.

2) If any of the above require Private deployment or HSM provisioning, please call that out and include estimated launch delta.

We’ve attached a short security appendix to be filled if needed. Timeline: PO target 2027-02-15.

Procurement Team
FinEdge
procurement@finedge.com

Attachment: finedge-security-appendix.docx
